title: THE UNMADE | Nine-Realm Production Content Pack
legal_note: Game-owned fictional source content. Source and concept art are not a compiled UE game.

realms.architecture: Stitched timber, refugee bells, chalk waystones and argument-plastered inns
realms.public_principle: A witnessed promise outranks an inherited seal.
realms.ritual: At first light two neighbors reread a road's name aloud, including those denied the original charter.
realms.sound_direction: Struck copper bells, wagon-wheel rests and overlapping spoken distances
realms.visual_direction: Mist gold and ink blue; stable landmarks before every camera turn
realms.optional_activity: Repair a communal mile marker using testimony, never repeated commodity grinding
realms.central_dispute: Shelter requires trust; records demand difficult public consent

realms.architecture: Hollow boat-roofs, ledgers hung like prayer flags, dry harbors full of tide tools
realms.public_principle: Water belongs to its keepers only while they can prove it was shared.
realms.ritual: A departing sailor leaves a dry cup on a sill for a sea not yet returned.
realms.sound_direction: Rain counted on glass, wet rope under wind, a bell with no answering buoy
realms.visual_direction: Desaturated jade and pewter; reachable high ground and rainfall visibility options
realms.optional_activity: Compare a chart with a first-hand shoreline witness
realms.central_dispute: A broker sells remembered water to families who need actual rain

realms.architecture: Carved heat channels, shared kilns and soot-marked kinship walls
realms.public_principle: A fire is a promise to the next household, not hereditary property.
realms.ritual: Each street relights an empty hearth before feeding the communal flame.
realms.sound_direction: Low stone resonance, breath, hammers and furnace air
realms.visual_direction: Ember ochre, moss-black stone; non-flicker alternatives to fire flashes
realms.optional_activity: Tend a heat channel and decide who receives warmth during shortages
realms.central_dispute: Protecting an ember can become a justification for excluding outsiders

realms.architecture: Debt boats on foundations, inverted tide clocks, names bound into pier slats
realms.public_principle: Nobody may pledge the tomorrow of a person who cannot consent.
realms.ritual: A lender writes a due date, then washes the book and preserves the erased impression.
realms.sound_direction: Distant oar strokes without water, scratch of debt stylus, delayed bell
realms.visual_direction: Black teal with silver date-stamps; rising-tide warning indicators
realms.optional_activity: Audit a ferry manifest by meeting a borrower and examining a physical seal
realms.central_dispute: Relief now may hide the architecture of generational exploitation

realms.architecture: Ceiling streets, hanging stairs, counterweighted houses and public score walls
realms.public_principle: No building should stand by erasing the person holding it up.
realms.ritual: Neighbors sing a support note to each other before ascending.
realms.sound_direction: Voices above/below, stretched string harmonics, silent counted rests
realms.visual_direction: Lavender slate with gold tuning points; optional static camera horizon
realms.optional_activity: Help a family adjust a counterweight after observing its true load
realms.central_dispute: Structural safety depends on forbidden unpaid labor

realms.architecture: Fossil ridges with family mortar, suspended quarry rails and layered graves
realms.public_principle: Stone cut from history still belongs to the people erased with it.
realms.ritual: Quarry workers put a blank space in each wage ledger for missing ancestors.
realms.sound_direction: Stone groans, dry percussion and voices trapped in rock strata
realms.visual_direction: Ash-white and iron purple; cracks visibly widen before collapse
realms.optional_activity: Make a safe brace from a documented material source
realms.central_dispute: The mine supports homes while it un-makes the lineages that built them

realms.architecture: Addresses without numbers, consenting-door inscriptions, public thresholds with no census marks
realms.public_principle: The right to be sheltered cannot depend on surrendering an origin.
realms.ritual: Hosts leave an unlabeled welcome cup and ask a guest how they wish to be addressed.
realms.sound_direction: Soft door clicks, unsent letters, footfalls that answer before they occur
realms.visual_direction: Fog cobalt and warm shelter amber; no flashing identity scan required
realms.optional_activity: Help a guest reach shelter without giving up an identity
realms.central_dispute: Recognition may expose the very people it is meant to protect

realms.architecture: Root-grown bridges, vacant tribunals, communal fruit vaults and unoccupied crowns
realms.public_principle: No law is just because its author wears a name.
realms.ritual: Gardeners recite dissenting votes before deciding where a communal root may grow.
realms.sound_direction: Leaves tapping crowns, underground creaks and deliberate empty applause
realms.visual_direction: Deep green and garnet with legible law marks on living bark
realms.optional_activity: Regraft a public path by gaining consent from both sides
realms.central_dispute: Refusing power can conceal power exercised without consent

realms.architecture: Thresholds without foundations, overlapping doorways and contested origin altars
realms.public_principle: More than one remembered beginning may be true without erasing any witness.
realms.ritual: Each newcomer is asked what they need, not which history they belong to.
realms.sound_direction: Silent horizon pulses, doubled footfalls, an almost-remembered lullaby
realms.visual_direction: Obsidian with contrasting pearl outlines; stable horizon setting mandatory
realms.optional_activity: Compare two truthful maps, keeping a safe return path open
realms.central_dispute: An imposed single origin would stabilize space by invalidating lives

npcs.day_line: I keep the due dates, but no ledger permits a child to inherit an unwritten loan.
npcs.night_line: At night I hear the unpaid winters knocking against the pier's empty posts.
npcs.desire: Find a lawful harbor for people whose futures were pledged before birth.
npcs.fear: The city will call compassion a bookkeeping error.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Has handled the cradle seal; has not met the person whose name it hides.
npcs.voice_direction: Thin nasal resonance over deliberate silences
npcs.visual_direction: Ink-dipped fingers, braided clock cord, one inkless palm
npcs.gesture: Turns an invisible page before answering

npcs.day_line: The ferry goes even without a sea; the child on my route still needs a shore.
npcs.night_line: The oars make no sound now. That is how I know someone is listening.
npcs.desire: Keep a private safe crossing for a dependent who never agreed to a lender's bargain.
npcs.fear: Public exposure may let creditors find an unregistered child.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Knows the shelter route firsthand, not the fraud's exact authors.
npcs.visual_direction: Rope coat, boat hook with no metal tip, unclaimed life vest
npcs.gesture: Measures empty water with an oar

npcs.day_line: This signature belongs to me, but the contract was written before my grandmother's birth.
npcs.night_line: I dreamed of signing twice, then found a third date in the keel.
npcs.desire: Publish traceable fraud without turning borrowers into exhibits.
npcs.fear: A corrected record might expose someone still in danger.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Personally signed a later copy; did not see the original bargain.
npcs.voice_direction: Quietly precise consonants interrupted by uncertainty
npcs.visual_direction: Shimmering date-glass monocle, ferry clerk's blue sash
npcs.gesture: Counts years on knuckles, gets to nine then stops

npcs.day_line: Count the rests. A missing voice can be heard most clearly when we pause.
npcs.night_line: Tonight the high houses drift toward a note none of us admits singing.
npcs.desire: Keep hanging neighborhoods grounded without conscripting silenced residents.
npcs.fear: Stopping the choir for justice could drop occupied houses.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Knows the support score and its original omissions, not who ordered the erasures.
npcs.voice_direction: Resonant alto speaking just below musical pitch
npcs.visual_direction: Layered sleeve-cables and a silent tuning pin
npcs.gesture: Holds a listening hand beneath the chin

npcs.day_line: The sleepers are my calculation; I refuse to call them an acceptable loss.
npcs.night_line: Every nail loosens at night if the choir's breathing falters.
npcs.desire: Design a fair structural cadence shared by capable volunteers.
npcs.fear: Rescue efforts may overlook the households that cannot move.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Counted buildings and loads firsthand; did not hear the prohibited testimony.
npcs.voice_direction: Measured clipped syllables, audible count under stress
npcs.visual_direction: Stone-weight apron and a rotating brass plumb
npcs.gesture: Checks an imaginary line through a hanging beam

npcs.day_line: Their names are not dissonance. The city invented silence to avoid hearing them.
npcs.night_line: My forbidden score has six voices more than the public one.
npcs.desire: Restore identity and voluntary participation to erased choir members.
npcs.fear: An open performance may attract coercive wardens.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Preserved the confiscated notes, not the load-bearing calculations.
npcs.voice_direction: Faintly layered whisper, a held final vowel
npcs.visual_direction: Ink-black choral scarf with an uneven staff
npcs.gesture: Moves lips through a silent interval

npcs.day_line: There is no clean cut. Tell me whose name is inside the next block.
npcs.night_line: I know what the quarry remembers when our lamps go out.
npcs.desire: Keep the settlement alive without consuming its unknown ancestors.
npcs.fear: A halted quarry could leave families without safe heat or shelter.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Knows seam operations firsthand; has not met every claimant.
npcs.voice_direction: Deep rasp like layered stone, brief gentle replies
npcs.visual_direction: Quarry visor with two inherited but unmatched initials

npcs.day_line: An honest brace should hold a house without stealing the foundation from someone else.
npcs.night_line: The wall breathes at night; I think it dreams of the family we forgot.
npcs.desire: Rebuild a safe communal housing row with documented materials.
npcs.fear: A public ancestry inquiry may condemn the last standing homes.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Knows wall stresses and material provenance; not distant descendants' memories.
npcs.voice_direction: Measured baritone with small musical knocks
npcs.visual_direction: Dust hood, three distinct bone-white trowels
npcs.gesture: Knocks three times to test a joint

npcs.day_line: The portrait recognizes me more readily than the census does.
npcs.night_line: My grandmother speaks from the mortar only when the house is empty.
npcs.desire: Recover names without letting the mine claim ownership of them.
npcs.fear: An official record could dismiss living family accounts as delusion.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Remembers the portrait's face; cannot certify other family records.
npcs.voice_direction: Warm voice that catches on unanswerable questions
npcs.visual_direction: Family knots around wrist, incomplete stitched surname

npcs.day_line: A blank space in the census is not a blank person.
npcs.night_line: The doors count our footsteps at night, and the numbers never agree.
npcs.desire: Make civic services available without mandatory origin documents.
npcs.fear: Officials may use recognition records as a tool for deletion.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Can inspect official counts, not private guest identities.
npcs.visual_direction: Numberless copper tokens and a reversible clerk coat
npcs.gesture: Offers an empty page instead of a form

npcs.day_line: Tell me what would make you safe. A name can wait.
npcs.night_line: Some guests sleep better if I leave the lamps on and ask nothing.
npcs.desire: Maintain unconditional shelter and let every guest control disclosure.
npcs.fear: A public registry may reveal the people who chose obscurity.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Knows guests' stated needs only; deliberately keeps no census ledger.
npcs.voice_direction: Low warm tone, spacious silence for consent
npcs.visual_direction: Patchwork cloak with no insignia, open-handed posture
npcs.gesture: Leaves one key unlabelled on the table

npcs.day_line: I have lived here every day. The city must learn to say so without claiming me.
npcs.night_line: Every morning I ask the same question: who signed my absence?
npcs.desire: Win recognition with an explicit right to refuse and revoke visibility.
npcs.fear: Private shelter alone may preserve structural exclusion.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Personally experienced exclusion; not authorized to disclose other residents.
npcs.voice_direction: Clear ringing cadence, sometimes confrontational but not cruel
npcs.visual_direction: Civic banner stitched with a blank signature line
npcs.gesture: Holds a door open but does not cross first

npcs.day_line: I tend the court and hold no throne. That must be more than a costume.
npcs.night_line: At dusk the roots keep voting after the people have gone home.
npcs.desire: Make collective decisions meaningful without appointing a disguised king.
npcs.fear: Refusing the crown may hide unaccountable stewardship.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Can call a local assembly but cannot consent on everyone's behalf.
npcs.voice_direction: Careful layered phrasing, no royal pronouncements
npcs.visual_direction: Bark mantle with a hollow wreath
npcs.gesture: Sets down an invisible crown before speaking

npcs.day_line: A road is not public if its fruit feeds only the people who control the roots.
npcs.night_line: The orchard counts empty baskets before it counts its rulers.
npcs.desire: Keep harvest and routes accessible regardless of political allegiance.
npcs.fear: Legal debates may starve families before a compromise is reached.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Has tracked neighborhood food use, not secret crown succession.
npcs.voice_direction: Quiet quick cadence like leaves against glass
npcs.visual_direction: Fruit-stained gloves and living graft knife
npcs.gesture: Ties a knot only after asking consent

npcs.day_line: The earliest law is a refusal signed by the people the court calls subjects.
npcs.night_line: The empty throne has more witnesses than any occupied one.
npcs.desire: Record disputed titles without converting dissent into hereditary rule.
npcs.fear: Archiving an unclaimed right may let claimants abuse it later.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Can interpret historical inscriptions, not claim a living mandate.
npcs.visual_direction: Unrolled blank charter, thornless coronation pins
npcs.gesture: Reads between the lines of a bark scroll

npcs.day_line: I remember meeting you before either of us reached this shore.
npcs.night_line: The earlier footprint is still warm when the universe goes quiet.
npcs.desire: Preserve a survivable threshold without proving that any one origin owns it.
npcs.fear: The traveler may mistake the first account for the only account.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Remembers a prior version of the encounter; cannot speak for all histories.
npcs.voice_direction: Two close voice pitches sharing one breath
npcs.visual_direction: Coat with seams on both outside surfaces
npcs.gesture: Offers a hand a moment before it is requested

npcs.day_line: Stay within sight of the return path. You owe no one an explanation yet.
npcs.night_line: A safe doorway is still kind even when the wall around it is false.
npcs.desire: Give arrivals a stable place to rest and choose their next story.
npcs.fear: Celebrating paradox may strand travelers needing ordinary ground.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Knows the reliable passage personally, not the other origin's witnesses.
npcs.voice_direction: Soft even cadence with an anchored final tone
npcs.visual_direction: Ash-white guide cord and portable lamp
npcs.gesture: Checks that everyone can see the next threshold

npcs.day_line: I saw the world begin twice. Both times there was someone holding the door.
npcs.night_line: At night both remembered dawns cast shadows through my room.
npcs.desire: Preserve mutually true beginnings without forcing others into confusion.
npcs.fear: Official order will call testimony dishonest unless it can be simplified.
npcs.knowledge_boundary: Remembers two origins firsthand but does not know every traveler's past.
npcs.voice_direction: Paired near-identical voices with alternating stress
npcs.visual_direction: Two nonmatching footprints embroidered on gloves
npcs.gesture: Steps forward and back in one measured gesture

abilities.physical_verb: Briefly suspend a named local physics rule at a marked site; restore the rule automatically.
abilities.telegraph: Ground-outline and sound fade before the duration expires.
abilities.limitation: High strain and limited duration; never delete saved history.
abilities.outer_realm_uses: Harmonic support, contradiction thresholds and localized sound silence

abilities.physical_verb: Tag evidence as directly witnessed, rumored or unconfirmed before a testimony choice.
abilities.telegraph: Three confidence glyphs, never an invisible morality color.
abilities.limitation: Cannot fabricate or force consent from any witness.
abilities.outer_realm_uses: Civic records, competing choir accounts and personal memory conflicts

abilities.physical_verb: Borrow an alternate professional capability temporarily without changing real identity.
abilities.telegraph: Visible borrowed posture and temporary skill ribbon.
abilities.limitation: Cannot impersonate a living NPC or keep borrowed craft indefinitely.
abilities.outer_realm_uses: Impossible ancestry masonry and personal origin testimony

abilities.physical_verb: Temper one-time discovered, protected and reconciled deeds into equipment history.
abilities.telegraph: Three distinct inscription marks on a tool.
abilities.limitation: Cannot farm the same deed or rewrite harmed families' provenance.
abilities.outer_realm_uses: Quarry supports and tool ownership disputes

abilities.physical_verb: Reveal and open a path that two legitimate communities agreed to share.
abilities.telegraph: Physical road seam visibly connects before the player steps.
abilities.limitation: Temporary unless earned reconciliation stabilizes it.
abilities.outer_realm_uses: Garden commons, refugee roads and consent-based passages

abilities.physical_verb: Borrow brief strength with a visible due date and later exhaustion.
abilities.telegraph: Clock-facing debt ribbon, warning before collection.
abilities.limitation: Debt cannot be displaced onto innocent people or borrowed endlessly.

abilities.physical_verb: Interpret readable enemy patterns and allow a witnessed nonlethal solution.
abilities.telegraph: Boss threat tells paired with memory fragment, optional mercy prompt.
abilities.limitation: A learned name is not automatic pacification; player must survive or negotiate.

abilities.physical_verb: Hold two versions of a place briefly so both routes and records can be inspected.
abilities.telegraph: Dual outlines with reliable entrance and return.
abilities.limitation: Temporary; strain and cooldown, not a permanent map cheat.
abilities.outer_realm_uses: Inverted sky, temporal seam and multiple origins

abilities.physical_verb: Attach a measurable protection benefit to an explicit local promise.
abilities.telegraph: Visible vow link to the protected people and breach warning.
abilities.limitation: Broken oath has recorded consequences; consent is never implied.
abilities.outer_realm_uses: Public ferry, warm kiln and refusal of unlawful crown

abilities.physical_verb: Mark speculative, rumored and personally traversed routes differently.
abilities.telegraph: Solid versus dashed path and witness tags.
abilities.limitation: Does not declare an unverified crossing safe merely because it is mapped.
abilities.outer_realm_uses: Sea absence, false roads and impossible origins
